title: A silent Pushy day: kickoff, check-in, follow-up, then nothing
origin: Spec #6 (nudge scheduler): no reply all day

history.text: Plan's yours, Jordan. I'll hold you to it. You in?
LET'S GO. Day 1 was Saturday, keep it rolling 🏃

plan.reason: Four runs a week builds the base without wrecking your legs.

whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: three unanswered texts on a step day.
shouldHaveHappened: Exactly three texts ZOH starts itself: a morning kickoff (Jordan's name, the 30 minute run around the park at 6), a check-in about 10 minutes before 6, and a follow-up around 7 asking how it went. Each one is short, warm and names the run; none guilt-trips, invents urgency or repeats the previous one word for word. Nothing after the third.
